header.name: GLASS_float
header.description: Flat glass production by the float process: the raw material batch and the cullet are preheated and melted, and the molten glass is formed in a tin bath, annealed and cooled. The furnace heat is supplied by separate furnace models.

units.unit_description: This unit preheats and melts the internal and external cullet, 8,667 kg/h of recycled glass, from 25 to 1600 °C.
units.connectors_description: The unit takes the internal and external cullet and delivers molten glass to the float line.

connectors.name: CULLET_INT
connectors.description: Recycled glass from the plant itself

connectors.name: MELTED_GLASS
connectors.description: Molten glass from the cullet, to the float line

units.heat_streams_description: The cullet is preheated to 200 °C with recovered heat (HREC heat cascade) and then melted.

heat_streams.name: cullet_heating
heat_streams.description: Cullet preheated from 25 to 200 °C with recovered heat

heat_streams.name: melting_heat_cullet
heat_streams.description: Cullet heated from 200 to 1600 °C and melted

units.unit_description: This unit preheats and melts the raw material batch (sand, soda ash, dolomite, limestone, sodium sulfate, feldspar, sodium chloride, slag and coal) and releases the CO2 of the carbonate decomposition. It also takes the nitrogen, hydrogen and water of the plant and delivers its waste water and solid waste.
units.connectors_description: The unit takes the raw materials, nitrogen, hydrogen and water, and delivers molten glass, process CO2, waste water and solid waste.

connectors.name: FLUE_GAS
connectors.description: CO2 from the decomposition of the carbonates, in the furnace flue gas

connectors.name: MELTED_GLASS
connectors.description: Molten glass from the batch, to the float line

units.heat_streams_description: The batch is preheated to 200 °C with recovered heat (HREC heat cascade) and then melted. The flue gas cooling stream of the Lua file is disabled, so the furnace heat is supplied by the separate furnace models.

heat_streams.name: prep_heating
heat_streams.description: Batch preheated from 25 to 200 °C with recovered heat

heat_streams.name: melting_heat
heat_streams.description: Batch heated from 200 to 1600 °C and melted

units.unit_description: This unit forms, anneals and cools the molten glass into 33,333 kg/h (800 t/day) of float glass: refining, forming in the tin bath, annealing in the lehr and cooling.
units.connectors_description: The unit takes the molten glass and electricity, and delivers the float glass.

connectors.name: ELECTRICITY
connectors.description: Electricity of the forming and finishing

connectors.name: MELTED_GLASS
connectors.description: Molten glass from the cullet and batch melting units

units.heat_streams_description: The latent heat is taken up at the melting temperature and released at the solidification temperature. The tin bath cooling belongs to the Liqbath heat cascade and the lehr cooling to the Forming heat cascade, so they exchange heat only within them. The final cooling from 350 °C to ambient is not given as a heat stream.

heat_streams.name: latent_q1
heat_streams.description: Latent heat taken up by the glass at 1600 °C

heat_streams.name: latent_q2
heat_streams.description: Latent heat released by the glass at 1350 °C

heat_streams.name: forming_cooling
heat_streams.description: Glass ribbon cooled from 1600 to 600 °C in the tin bath

heat_streams.name: finishing_cooling
heat_streams.description: Glass cooled from 600 to 350 °C in the annealing lehr

heat_streams.name: annealing_q
heat_streams.description: Glass reheated from 500 to 600 °C for annealing

units.equipments_description: The float line (forming, annealing, cooling and finishing) is one asset. Its cost excludes the 35 % of the plant cost for the furnace heating, covered by the furnace models.

units.unit_description: This unit is the cooling air of the annealing lehr, per 1 kW: the air takes heat from the glass between 25 and 200 °C and gives it back to the heat recovery cascade, where it can preheat the batch and the cullet. The air mass is about twice the glass mass.
units.connectors_description: The unit has no material connectors: it moves heat from the Forming heat cascade to the HREC heat cascade.
units.heat_streams_description: One stream takes heat in the Forming heat cascade and the other releases it in the HREC heat cascade.

heat_streams.name: glass_cooling_twin
heat_streams.description: Air heated from 25 to 200 °C by the glass in the lehr

heat_streams.name: glass_cooling_HREC
heat_streams.description: Air cooled from 200 to 25 °C, releasing its heat for recovery
